title: The formula by its words

members.role: the bar the first input is read off is lit as its term is written - the input's source on the page
the row in spoken order: each input on its own word, the operator just before the next, '=' and the signed result on the word that says it (P70 T6)

does: The bar an input comes from is lit as the hand writes it, and the arithmetic is built in the order it is spoken - each input on its word, the signed result on its own.

use_when.act: EXPLAINS - the arithmetic IS the claim (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R25)
use_when.shape: two numbers -> one: sourced inputs (or a named scenario) and a result the voice says
use_when.use: H row 18's 'At a fifth of the index, if the AI names fall by half, that erases ten percent' - 20% x -1/2 = -10%, each on its word, the 20 lit on its bar
use_when.dont: the arithmetic is not the claim (the guide's don't); an input unsourced or the result unspoken (species:equation's when); a term read off a CLAIM unmarked (P73 T1)

source: P71 T34 (harvest v2 R25; DOM 09:30-09:39, the 'Real Yield' tiles in spoken order); proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t34.py on Steel and Paper H row 18 ('Run the arithmetic. At a fifth of the index ... erases ten percent', take 398.14 s) on ev-index-concentration-bars-v1 in the long form, the terms P70 T6's golden's - no approved cut carries it
